name: ss
description: Ship Shape (ss): technical skills for building software, invoked as /ss:<skill>. The flow is shape → build → ship (/ss:shape aligns on a spec, /ss:build runs it, /ss:ship lands the branch) and a per-project wiki at .ss/wiki/ that shape and build keep up to date, with /ss:review, /ss:review-setup, /ss:gather-branch-context, /ss:maintain-repo, /ss:research, /ss:write-readme and /ss:orchestrate alongside. It never merges, with one exception: /ss:orchestrate merges a PR only on the person's explicit authorization, given in their own conversation, and under the repository's rules.
